title: feat(auth): allow explicit intranet HTTP OAuth
body:
Non-loopback HTTP deployments currently keep the MCP OAuth surface disabled even when an operator has explicitly chosen an isolated intranet deployment. This adds a default-off escape hatch: only `OS_ALLOW_INSECURE_OAUTH_HTTP=true` enables MCP OAuth for those origins; HTTPS and loopback behavior is unchanged, and malformed values remain denied.

The auth-manager coverage verifies the URL boundary and metadata advertisement, the mount warning names the opt-in, and the package receives a patch changeset.

Validation:

- `git diff --check`
- `vitest run src/auth-manager.mcp-oauth.test.ts` — 42 tests passed against the 17.4.0 published workspace dependencies in a sparse checkout

The draft remains open for the repository CI and full workspace typecheck/build before merge.
